messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: greedy local search over continuous coordinates with simulated annealing

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Simulated annealing over the 26 continuous coordinates of 13 points, initialized from a perturbed hexagonal lattice and minimizing the negative log of the minimum triangle area, converges to a configuration where the largest achievable minimum triangle area equals approximately 1/132. The optimal configuration breaks the full symmetry of the hexagonal lattice, retaining only a reflection symmetry, with several points pushed to the boundary of the unit square to maximize the bottleneck triangle area."}
